svg.title: Call intelligence architecture
svg.desc: Transcripts flow from the transcription platform to Cloud Storage to BigQuery. From there, the Gemini API writes a structured summary, an LLM labels resolution, and SQL computes operational metrics. The topic model (XLNet on four L4 GPUs) and regex entity matching read the summary. A consolidation step waits for all five jobs, then writes one dashboard table that powers the dashboard.
svg.text: runs only after all five jobs succeed
one row per call · partitioned by call_date
